name: Outbound SCIM
description: Provision users and groups to an external system through the SCIM protocol.

fields.name: federatedAppId
fields.description: The ID of the federated application this SCIM connector provisions for.

fields.name: baseUrl
fields.description: The base URL of the SCIM server that users and groups are provisioned to.

fields.name: authentication
fields.description: The authentication used when calling the SCIM server.

fields.name: headers
fields.description: Additional HTTP headers to send with each request to the SCIM server.

fields.name: hmacSecret
fields.description: A secret used to sign requests to the SCIM server with an HMAC signature.

fields.name: insecure
fields.description: Whether to skip verification of the SCIM server's TLS certificate.
